shortDescription: Dr. Sun Pengbo, a former reinforcement learning expert at ByteDance and former head of Tencent Robotics X's agent center, has officially joined Stardust Intelligence, where he will focus on robot reinforcement learning research and application development, according to Jiemian News.

title: Former ByteDance and Tencent Robotics X Expert Sun Pengbo Joins Stardust Intelligence
